passage:
Mandy's cat, Cookie, became famous online by accident. Mandy posted a short video of Cookie opening a drawer and taking out a pair of socks. The next morning, the video had thousands of views.
At first, Mandy was happy. She filmed Cookie every day. Cookie eating, Cookie sleeping, Cookie sitting in a box-everything became a video.
After a few weeks, Cookie started hiding whenever Mandy picked up her phone. Mandy's brother said, "Maybe Cookie doesn't want to be a star."
Mandy felt bad. She deleted some videos and stopped filming Cookie all the time. Now she only takes pictures when Cookie is relaxed, and she never wakes him up for a video.
Mandy learned that likes from strangers are exciting, but they are not more important than the comfort of someone who trusts you-even if that someone is a cat.
